2609.18304.title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2609.18304.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks through multi-step environment interaction, yet a single erroneous action can alter subsequent states and observations, causing errors to compound over time. Existing methods either correct the context without repairing altered environment states or restore earlier states while discarding useful experience, making it difficult to both eliminate failure conditions and avoid repeating past mistakes. We argue that reliable recovery should instead be treated as a rollback-boundary control problem that jointly determines when to intervene, where to resume, and what information should survive recovery. Based on this view, we propose Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR), a unified recovery framework that restores execution to a selected prior state while carrying forward reusable knowledge distilled from the abandoned trajectory to guide subsequent decisions. We further characterize recovery through a unified operator over rollback depth and retained memory, providing a general view of state restoration and knowledge retention. Experiments on three long-horizon benchmarks demonstrate that RIR consistently improves task performance across multiple LLM backbones, with structured reflection memory preserving useful experience and selective rollback enabling efficient recovery.
2609.18304.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理越來越多地通過多步環境互動來處理長期任務，但單一的錯誤行動可能會改變後續的狀態和觀察，導致錯誤隨時間累積。現有的方法要麼在不修復改變的環境狀態下修正上下文，要麼恢復早期狀態的同時丟棄有用的經驗，這使得消除失敗條件和避免重複過去錯誤變得困難。我們認為，可靠的恢復應被視為一個回滾邊界控制問題，這個問題共同決定何時介入、從何處恢復以及哪些信息應該在恢復過程中保留。基於這一觀點，我們提出了回滾誘導反思（RIR），這是一個統一的恢復框架，能夠將執行恢復到選定的先前狀態，同時將從放棄的軌跡中提煉出的可重用知識向前推進，以指導後續的決策。我們進一步通過對回滾深度和保留記憶的統一運算符來表徵恢復，提供了狀態恢復和知識保留的一般視角。在三個長期基準上的實驗表明，RIR在多個LLM骨幹上持續提高任務性能，結構化反思記憶保留了有用的經驗，而選擇性回滾則實現了高效的恢復。
